def coords(s, x):
    p = s['panel_a']
    (u, v) = (p['u'], p['v'])
    F = AF(u)
    (_, _, e) = cal(s, x)
    w = fit(F[e < 2], v[e < 2])
    z = np.linalg.solve(w[1:5].T, (x - w[0]).T).T
    for j in range(12):
        J = np.broadcast_to(w[1:5], (len(z), 4, 4)).copy()
        K = w[5:9]
        rr = np.roll(z, -1, axis=1)
        J += rr[:, :, None] * K[None, :, :] + np.roll(z[:, :, None] * K[None, :, :], 1, axis=1) + 3 * z[:, :, None] ** 2 * w[None, 9:13, :]
        dz = np.linalg.solve(J.transpose(0, 2, 1), (AF(z) @ w - x)[..., None])[..., 0]
        z -= np.clip(dz, -0.4, 0.4)
    return z
